class.name: ProcessMemory
class.brief_description: The memory of the whole process, as the system sees it.
class.description: Not Godot's own count of its allocations ([constant Performance.MEMORY_STATIC]), which misses native buffers and the memory the allocator keeps after it is freed.

method.name: get_resident_bytes
method.description: Resident set size in bytes; -1 where it is not known (Linux only).

method.name: release_unused
method.description: Gives the memory the allocator keeps free back to the system (glibc only).
